title: Pilsen Chicago Walking Tour: Street Art & Mexican History
includes: In-depth explanation of the murals. Free entrance to the National Museum of Mexican Art
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Pilsen, one of Chicago’s most vibrant neighborhoods, known for its colorful street art, rich Mexican heritage, historic architecture, and thriving local culture. This locally led Pilsen walking tour offers an authentic, insider experience beyond typical Chicago sightseeing.

- Pilsen-based experts with 40+ years of combined experience

- Explore iconic sites like 16th Street murals, Thalia Hall, and local cultural landmarks

- Official Pilsen tour partner of the Chicago History Museum 

- Bilingual tours available in English and Spanish

- Multiple routes and flexible options, including walking, running, or biking tours

-BOOKING: Please note the tour guide will contact you to schedule an exact time for your tour after you have completed the booking. There is no option to pick a start time.
